headline: Papal Visit to Peru Expected to Boost SME Sales and Economic Activity
summary: The upcoming visit of Pope Leo XIV to Peru between November 11 and 16 is projected to generate between S/700 million and S/1,200 million in economic activity, boosting small and medium-sized enterprise sales by 20% to 40%.
why: Large-scale papal and international events drive domestic tourism, hospitality revenue, and retail spending in host cities, temporarily lifting local service sectors.

impacts.name: Retail and SMEs
impacts.why: Inflow of visitors during the papal visit is projected to increase sales.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
